## 🧠 About Me

I enjoy building responsive, clean, and user-friendly web experiences. I am currently focused on sharpening my fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while developing practical projects to solve real-world problems. 

My growth as a developer is driven by a deep commitment to consistency, hands-on practice, and the compounding power of small, continuous improvements.

**Here's a quick summary about me:**

- 💬 **Pronouns:** He/him
- 💡 **Fun Fact:** I'm currently enrolled at AltSchool Africa [School of Software Engineering](https://portal.altschoolafrica.com/auth/signin?ref=YmcTWw) Karatu Cohort of 2026, studying under AI-Powered FullStack Engineering track.
- 🌱 **Learning Journey:** I'm currently expanding my skills in JavaScript, React.js, and Node.js.
- 🤝 **Collaboration:** I’m looking for help with open source projects and hackathons. I'm also open to collaborations on impactful projects/solutions and anything I can be of help with. let's build together!
- 💼 **Job Interests:** Seeking internships, entry-level roles, or collaborative positions as a Software Engineer, Front-End Engineer, or UI Engineer.
- 📫 **Reach Me:** You can [view my resume](#) and contact me by emailing `Cyb3rc.de@gmail.com`.

## 🕹️ When VS Code is Closed...

- 🏃‍♂️ My system runs a background process called `"having a life"`, though the documentation on that is still pretty vague.
- 🎮 I switch over to high-performance gaming mode, usually deploying for hot drops in PUBG or hitting the pitch in eFootball.
- 🎧 I stream media assets in high-definition, balancing out my logic blocks with music, movies or documentries().
- 🛌 I eventually enter deep sleep mode to clear my cache, fix memory leaks, and restart my system for the next day.
